title: [Nichibei] My Lessons – Browse/Reserve New Lesson Button Hides When the Student's Only LA Archives
description: AC-5 (parity) - Regression - control case: Code-confirmed getReservationSetting() already excludes archived LAs from its active-LA count (Archived_At__c = NULL, cls:570).
preconditions: Student A has exactly one active Lesson Allocation; the "Browse Lessons" (+) / "Reserve New Lesson" button is currently visible on the My Lessons screen
steps_actions:
1. "Student A opens the 'Lesson Booking' menu and confirms the Browse/Reserve New Lesson button is visible"
2. "The Student Package Order group behind Student A's Lesson Allocation is fully removed, so the Lesson Allocation is archived"
3. "Student A reopens the 'Lesson Booking' menu"
4. "A living Student Package Order reappears for Student A's Student Course, so the Lesson Allocation is unarchived on the same record Id"
5. "Student A reopens the 'Lesson Booking' menu"
steps_result:
1. "Button visible and tappable"
2. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c populated"
3. "The Browse/Reserve New Lesson button is no longer visible; the 'No courses available for booking' empty state is shown"
4. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c blank again"
5. "The Browse/Reserve New Lesson button is visible again"
steps_data:
1. "Archived_At__c = blank"
2. "Archived_At__c = current timestamp"
3. "Archived LA excluded from allowReserveMore's count"
4. "Archived_At__c = null (restored)"
5. "Archived_At__c = blank (restored)"

title: [Nichibei] My Lessons – Booking Hidden When Its Lesson Allocation Archives; Restored – Reappears
description: AC-5 / AC-3 (parity) - Regression - control case: Code-confirmed getReservationList() already filters Is_Archived__c = FALSE (cls:505) on the student's own booked-lesson list.
preconditions: Student A has a booked lesson (Booking_Flag = TRUE, lesson_date >= today) currently shown on the My Lessons screen
steps_actions:
1. "Student A opens My Lessons and confirms the booked lesson card is shown"
2. "The Student Package Order group behind Student A's Lesson Allocation is fully removed, so the Lesson Allocation is archived"
3. "Student A reopens My Lessons"
4. "A living Student Package Order reappears for Student A's Student Course, so the Lesson Allocation is unarchived on the same record Id"
5. "Student A reopens My Lessons"
steps_result:
1. "Lesson card visible"
2. "The Student Session becomes Is_Archived__c = TRUE via formula"
3. "The booking no longer appears in the list"
4. "The Student Session returns to Is_Archived__c = FALSE"
5. "The booking reappears - the same original Student Session, not a new one"
steps_data:
1. "Student Session Is_Archived__c = FALSE"
2. "Archived_At__c = current timestamp"
3. "Excluded by getReservationList's Is_Archived__c = FALSE filter"
4. "Archived_At__c = null (restored)"
5. "Session restored, not duplicated"
